verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says SSL is 'live from the moment you deploy', so the platform does provision TLS for public endpoints. The evidence never says the certificates are free, auto-renewing, cover custom domains, or support wildcards. A community report of certificates showing as invalid during a GCP outage reflects an incident, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: documented automatic renewal, wildcard certificate support, explicit coverage of every custom domain, confirmation that certificates are free, and in-depth first-party docs or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
